description: Tap to drop heavy blocks from the sky and crush crystal targets below. Chain drops for combo multipliers — 3 levels of physics destruction!
fireSafetyLesson: Heavy things fall fast — never stand under anything that could drop on you!
title: Inferno Drop

description: Ruko sprints upward non-stop through a lava cavern! Tap left/right to switch lanes, dodge lava geysers, grab stars for near-miss combos.
fireSafetyLesson: Running from danger is smart — but always run TOWARD a grown-up or an exit, never deeper inside!
title: Flame Sprint 2D

description: Top-down bumper arena! Ram rival fire babies to knock them out of the ring. Drag or use arrow keys — last one in the ring wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Pushing and shoving is never safe play — in games AND in real life, keep your hands to yourself!
title: Blaze's Thermal Run

description: Tap IN RHYTHM with the drum beat to leap each lava gap! Perfect timing builds combo multipliers. 3 misses and it's splashdown!
fireSafetyLesson: Lava is pretend-hot, but real stoves are REALLY hot — never touch without a grown-up!
title: Ruko's Lava Leap

description: Hop Cinder up endless fortress towers! Tap left/right to hop, land on platforms, grab gems. Moving platforms crumble — keep climbing!
fireSafetyLesson: Climbing is fun on playgrounds — but never climb on stoves, heaters, or anything hot!
title: Boulder's Fortress

description: Aim the ballista! Drag to pull back, release to launch water balloons at crystal targets. Moving targets pay bonus — 60 seconds on the clock!
fireSafetyLesson: Water puts out small fires! But firefighters handle big ones — always get help from a grown-up!
title: Sizzle's Target Pop

description: Tap groups of 2+ matching magma blocks to smash them! Bigger groups = bigger combos. Clear blocks before the stack reaches the top!
fireSafetyLesson: Match the right tool to the job — water for small fires, but ALWAYS call 911 for big ones!
title: Magma Block Breaker

description: Drag Ruko left & right to catch falling crystals! Dodge the burning meteors — 3 hits and it's over. Chain catches for combo multipliers!
fireSafetyLesson: Catch falling stars in games — but NEVER try to catch anything falling in real life! Let it drop and step back!
title: Crater Catcher

description: Tug-of-war against the ash storm! TAP RAPIDLY to pull the rope and keep Boulder anchored. Survive the growing gusts!
fireSafetyLesson: In smoky air, stay LOW where the air is clearer — smoke rises, so crawl under it!
title: Ash Storm Survivor

description: Draw a path with your finger and Sizzle follows it! Reach the water pool before time runs out. Avoid the lava pits — 5 levels!
fireSafetyLesson: Plan your escape route BEFORE there's an emergency — draw your family's fire escape map today!
title: Lava Line Draw

description: Grapple-paddle showdown! Drag your paddle to smack the ember ball past the CPU. Curved grapple shots! First to 7 wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Paddles are for ping-pong, not for hitting! Play safe and take turns!
title: Pyra Paddle Battle

description: Grid tactics! Tap YOUR embers, then tap a glowing square to bounce-move. Capture CPU embers by landing on them. Most embers wins!
fireSafetyLesson: Think before you act! A good plan keeps everyone safe — in games and in fire drills!
title: Ember Bounce 2D
